sentences.text: The instant petition seeks quashing of the first information report dated 22.09.2019 registered as Case Crime No.1147 of 2019, under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C. P.S. Noida Sector-20, District Gautam Budh Nagar.
The allegations in the impugned first information report are in respect of misusing online procedure for grant of NOC from the fire department in respect of buildings.
The allegation is that the accused have submitted multiple applications with same identity in respect of multiple building for the purpose of obtaining NOC from the fire department.
As against the petitioner it is alleged that he has submitted three applications.

The contention of learned counsel for the petitioner is that earlier also a first information report was lodged againstthe petitioner in respect of making an attempt to give bribe to the official concerned in which the petitioner has been granted bail by order dated 7th December, 2019 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application no.54360 of 2019 and therefore this impugned first information report is actually a second first information report.
The aforesaid contention of learned counsel for the petitioner cannot be accepted because the charge is apparently different.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application no.54360 of 2019
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Otherwise also, since the allegations disclose commission of cognizable offences, the matter would require investigation.
Hence, the prayer of the petitioner to quash the first information report cannot be accepted.
In such view of the matter, the present petition is not maintainable.

We further find that in the first paragraph, it has been mentioned that it is first criminal misc. writ petition filed before this Court for the same cause of action clearly shows that it is false in nature.
Therefore, we dismiss this writ petition with costs of Rs.20,000/- to be paid by the petitioner within a period of one month in favour of the Legal Aid Committee of this Court.
In case of default in payment of aforesaid cost, the Registrar General will send notice to the District Magistrate concerned for recovery from the petitioner.
